notes.title: Free Payday style FPS One Armed Robber adds seven new weapons
notes.content:
Payday 3 has come a long way since launch, but it's yet to rival the highs of its predecessor. In the meantime, however, another free-to-play heist FPS is making a big name for itself on Steam, racking up an impressive ratio of 91% recommendations from more than 32,000 reviews. This is One-Armed Robber, a simple but surprisingly satisfying spin on the high-stakes combination of stealth and explosions. As 2025 rolls in, developer Duhndal follows up its recently introduced mansion mission with a fresh kit of seven new weapons, making now an ideal time to discover why it's so beloved.

notes.title: Mansion heist
notes.content:
Step into the action with the latest map for one-armed robber: the Mansion Heist. The heist takes place during the millionaire owner’s extravagant birthday party, where he’s celebrating his latest indulgence—a cutting-edge supercar, gifted to himself and secured in the basement garage. The newly acquired car is yet to be installed with tracking features, so this is your chance to strike.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44504757/33d6f852c08208ecc5a8af43e47f82045e3b9971.png[/img]
As you infiltrate the party, you’ll need to bypass advanced laser grids, dodge high-tech security cameras, and outmaneuver patrolling guards, all while staying out of sight from the festive guests.
The map is packed with features to test your ingenuity, including hackable security systems, and multiple entry points, allowing you to tailor your approach to the heist.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44504757/3ae0be73269ef02b3dc7c5d3b47f3b862757b658.png[/img]
Can you outsmart the millionaire, outwit his security, and make your daring getaway? The stakes are high, and the spotlight is on you.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44504757/7611b005cbb7be94e89b5dc9ba07f548dff74cf5.png[/img]

notes.title: Black Diamond Casino
notes.content:
Black Diamond Casino - try to win it big on the slots, or try to win bigger by robbing the place!

This casino is filled to the brim with money, in the form of chips, cash and bonds! This also means that the casino is strictly secured with guards and cameras around every corner, and state of the art security systems. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44504757/a9d59aba3f6589b52e2cbd4437d7d08ec3cc5508.png[/img]

If you manage to sneak around security and make your way into the vault, the high-tech security system will reveal itself. Inside the vault is 2 arrays of lasers which can be deactivated, but only for 30 seconds at a time, so you will have to hurry in order to not be trapped inside the vault!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44504757/7c787a51f7b5b58cb992905b5101818effac5779.png[/img]

Snoop around a little further and you will find a guarded basement locked with a biometric hand scanner, this scummy casino is the weekly gathering point for mobsters, who gather and play poker while they do their dealings. This is the perfect time to interrupt as the basement will be filled with valuables. But only the hand of a mobster can unlock the door!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44504757/87b851013a90a6cb6897ece9679bf42ecf949764.png[/img]

[previewyoutube=5Sa1PTNIq4w;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Skills!
notes.content:
It’s time to become the best one-armed version of yourself, and become a skillful robber!

Skills are now a part of one-armed robber, giving you the ability to unlock skills to suit your playstyle, and gain an advantage in heists. 
Skills such as “Scavenger” which will give you more ammo from police ammo drops, or “Saboteur” which will speed up your powerbox sabotage speeds!

To acquire these skills you will have to research them, you pay cash to start the research, the skill research will then progress when you play the game, once the research is finished, the skill will be unlocked and automatically equipped.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44504757/57fe442f1a604e8bb972bbbb8970d7f53d733409.png[/img]

You can research multiple skills at once, but your research XP will be divided equally among the skills.

Each skill has 3 tiers, each one a little better than the last, once a tier is completed, you will be able to see and research the next tier.

notes.title: Sounds and Music!
notes.content:
An aspect of the game that has been lacking has been the sounds. A lot of items have had missing sound effects, and ambient sounds and music were non-existent. But not anymore!

A lot of you have also been asking for this update for a long time, and we’ve spent a lot of time finding and recording sounds. This update adds sounds to a lot of new things, this includes sound fx for objects, but also ambient and environment sounds. 

As well as a bunch of sound effects, this update also adds music! This includes menu music, and music for when the alarm is tripped ingame. Some of this music is temporary, while we work on creating our own original music for the game.

We’ve also added a few more achievements

notes.title: Achievements
notes.content:
You will now be able to unlock achievements by completing various challenges and tasks in-game. There are more than 30 achievements to unlock, ranging from Picking locks to killing police!

Although many of you might technically already have reached one or more achievements during your time playing the game previously, that unfortunately won’t count towards progress for the achievements. And all achievement progress will only start counting from this update forward!

notes.title: Rodman research facility update
notes.content:
We’ve slightly changed the layout of the map to make it a little easier and to give you some more ways to complete the heist. A warehouse has been added to the back of the building, giving you another place to enter through. The layout of the building is still the same on the inside except for the new entrance.

The value of the beakers has also been increased to match the difficulty and length of the map.

The map has also been upgraded visually in some places by adding some more details, and changing the overall look of some areas.

notes.title: Changes to the appearance shop
notes.content:
[b]Appearance shop[/b]
We have decided to change the way the appearance shop works in the game. From now on, there will only be 2 weekly items, the “featured items” section will become “all items”, and almost all previous items will be available in the shop.

We’ve decided to make this change because we want to spend our time on making new gameplay content and maps for the game. We were spending too much of our time making skins, and not enough time on content. We have a lot of plans for the game, and since we’re a small team, it was hard to allocate enough time towards it.
We hope you can understand our decision. Expect to see more content very soon!


[b]Civilian casualty penalty[/b]
We’ve also added a “civilian casualty penalty” meaning if you kill civilians you will be punished by having some of your total take taken from you at the end of the game. This makes it more attractive to tie up civilians instead of shooting them.

notes.title: Lundenburg Liquors
notes.content:
This liquor shop is like most others, however they also have one of the most expensive wine collections in the country. You can find this collection in their wine cellar. Since their collection is so expensive, they also made an effort to secure the place, by purchasing top of the line security systems such as lasers, and security tags on their most expensive wine bottles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44504757/866965374228a890dbfe1b01bce5079aa2d0087d.png[/img]

The wine cellar is divided into six cells, each with a shelf containing various wines. Behind the bars of each cell is an array of lasers, if anything touches these lasers, the alarm will go off, luckily you can disable the lasers, using the box in the far end of the room.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44504757/5ea1a6e20bbe00f04db229a92fd1e3b00a35b280.png[/img]

Once inside the cells, you will notice, that some of the bottles have a white cap on them, this is a security tag. At the entrance of the wine cellar is a security tag detector, which will set off the alarm if any of the bottles leave the room, therefore you will have to find a way to disable the security tag detector before getting the bottles out.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44504757/e467bea28d64272e97adcb94e831fa1120255afa.png[/img]

notes.title: New maps and special police types!
notes.content:
The first content update for One-armed robber is here, with 2 new maps, and special police units, there is a lot to get excited about!

[h2]Maps[/h2]
[b]Liberty Hawk bank[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44504757/dc5fac390d4b6e59313afb40935708beecd8df47.png[/img]
A small bank in the city, perfect for the inexperienced robber. This bank doesn’t have any advanced security systems, but also doesn’t contain that much cash. This bank is perfect for a novice robber learning the ropes, or an experienced robber wanting an easy challenge.

[b]Rodman Research Facility[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44504757/66936174f229b97f14239c8b0cf7d4fd158f2976.png[/img]
This remote research facility is developing secret chemical weapons that are worth a lot of money in the right hands! In each room is a beaker with the chemical compound, put this through the centrifuge in the laboratory to transform it into a high-value chemical weapon, which is worth a lot.

[h2]Special police units[/h2]
[b]Powerbox defuser[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44504757/af36f4762efdad1abc8466f8713c52c50e8f77eb.png[/img]
Now with its very own special unit, the powerbox defuser does what regular police previously did; defuse powerboxes. However the special unit moves a lot faster, and is unarmed, making his only target the powerboxes, so watch out for him! turning your back to a powerbox for just a few seconds, and he might have defused it.

[b]Juggernaut[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44504757/b9562607f5c15aa78bca1eef68c9b3599445ab85.png[/img]
The Juggernaut unit is equipped with a heavy machine gun, and his heavy armored suit makes him incredibly difficult to get rid of, but also very slow. Shooting him through the face visor is probably your best option.

[b]Interceptor[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44504757/d67166214d8846c02d84c5b849a698ded3b840d8.png[/img]
The Interceptor is a sneaky guy, running around placing barbed wire traps in doorways and other places. These traps will slow you down, making you an easy target for the police, shoot the barbed wire to get rid of it, and shoot the interceptor to stop him from placing barbed wire.

[b]Shield[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44504757/c5bd62d9958e27ae88b670c845832df432458c1e.png[/img]
This unit carries a completely bulletproof shield in one hand, and wields a pistol in the other. The shield makes him very difficult to kill, however the shield has a weakness; the glass. Breaking the glass gives you direct visibility to his head, making it easy to take him out. Alternatively you can try to shoot at any limbs visible around the shield.

[b]Blinding shield[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44504757/fc9fcd6f81994d3ee71b49bb4be348c2f4fa7a5f.png[/img]
very similar to the regular shield unit, except this guy has a shield equipped with extremely bright lights that will blind anyone in front of them. Try to shoot this guy before he has a chance to activate them!

notes.title: This free Steam game is like Payday 3, but with a chaotic twist
notes.content:
Payday 3 is a heist game with a lot of promise, but there's definitely some creases to be ironed out, and if you're already a big fan of the FPS series then you've probably already snuck, stormed, and blasted your way through everything that Payday 2 has to offer, and we've all had our fill of the GTA 5 heists by now. But what about something new? One-Armed Robber is the follow-up to a beloved 2022 co-op game, puts a distinctive spin on the heist simulator (you can probably already guess what it is), and best of all is a free Steam game.

notes.title: Release patch
notes.content:
The game has been out for a couple of days, and we've fixed some bugs that we missed before release, and tweaked some things to make the game easier for new players.

*New players now start with a suppressor and a lock pick, making it possible to go stealth from the beginning.

*Increased damage on secondary weapons.

*Fixed loadout not saving between games.

*An “Equip” button will now appear in the shop after buying equipment, or when selecting an “Already owned” item.

*Tools will now automatically equip after purchase, if there is an empty slot on your equipment shelf.

*Fixed “Find game” issues.

*Other minor bug fixes.
